scripts.dev: echo "run 'pnpm dev-server' in the root directory instead" >&2 && exit 1
scripts.build:worker: node scripts/build-browser-runtime.ts && pnpm exec capnweb-validate build --out .wrangler/validate

scripts.test:book:storage: node scripts/build-browser-runtime.ts && node scripts/build-bundled-blueprints.ts && vitest run --config vitest.book.config.ts
scripts.test:book:mcp: node scripts/build-browser-runtime.ts && node scripts/build-bundled-blueprints.ts && node scripts/book-tests/run-mcp.mjs
scripts.test:book:migration: node scripts/build-browser-runtime.ts && node scripts/build-bundled-blueprints.ts && vitest run --config vitest.book-migration.config.ts
scripts.test:book:children: node scripts/build-browser-runtime.ts && node scripts/build-bundled-blueprints.ts && vitest run --config vitest.child-books.config.ts
scripts.test:book:upgrade: node scripts/build-browser-runtime.ts && node scripts/build-bundled-blueprints.ts && vitest run --config vitest.book-upgrade.config.ts
scripts.test:go:live: node scripts/build-browser-runtime.ts && node scripts/build-bundled-blueprints.ts && vitest run --config vitest.go-live.config.ts
scripts.test:go:contract: node scripts/build-browser-runtime.ts && node scripts/build-bundled-blueprints.ts && node scripts/go-tests/run-contract.mjs
